mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT sum(residual_waste_count) + sum(recyclable_count) + sum(food_waste_count) + sum(hazardous_waste_count) AS count, DATE(`date`) AS `date` FROM bin INNER JOIN cluster INNER JOIN count ON bin.cluster_id = cluster.cluster_id AND bin.bin_id = count.bin_id WHERE bin.cluster_id = #{clusterId} GROUP BY DATE(`date`) ORDER BY DATE(`date`) DESC LIMIT 5) as t ORDER BY DATE(`date`);

SELECT t.date, SUM(t.residual_waste_count) AS residual_waste_count, SUM(t.recyclable_count) AS recyclable_count, SUM(t.food_waste_count) AS food_waste_count, SUM(t.hazardous_waste_count) AS hazardous_waste_count FROM (SELECT count.residual_waste_count, count.recyclable_count, count.food_waste_count, count.hazardous_waste_count, count.date FROM count LEFT JOIN bin ON count.bin_id = bin.bin_id WHERE bin.cluster_id = #{clusterId} ORDER BY DATE(`date`) DESC LIMIT 5) AS t GROUP BY t.date ORDER BY DATE(`date`);
SELECT * FROM (SELECT methane_value AS value, date AS date FROM value WHERE bin_id = #{binId} ORDER BY `date` DESC LIMIT 5) as vd ORDER BY `date`;
SELECT * FROM (SELECT smog_value AS value, date AS date FROM value WHERE bin_id = #{binId} ORDER BY `date` DESC LIMIT 5) as vd ORDER BY `date`;
